author: dmunagavalasa
body: are we silently denying this error from getting reported in sentry ? if yes is this the only fix that we can do ?

author: gkrishna214
body:
Actually yes. We will lose visibility into any new Doc360 bugs. 
But the trade off here is :
Since it's third-party code we can't fix, that might be fine.

Another solution :
We can filter out url_mapping from from doc360. So it preserves reporting for other Doc360 bugs.
But we might need updates if Doc360 throws new stale-interval errors with different messages.

So sticked for solution - 1.
